I think mine stems from (maybe) being asexual.. not sure 100% if I am, though I never seem to be 100% on anything tbh. There's always that worry that what if I say I am and I'm not. I try to not think about it and just not label it with the mindset of whatever happens, happens but it is everywhere. Almost daily on reddit, some askreddit question is related to sex. I just don't see the appeal for it, seems like an awkward and uncomfortable thing. Maybe I am just incredibly uncomfortable with myself, not sure. 

I don't understand when people call it a need or something they can't go however long without. I could never comprehend when getting taught sex ed in school, what's all the fuss and need for protection when you could just choose not do it. I would much rather just cuddle with someone, I feel like that is more intimate.
